We are beyond happy that we chose Dalchini catering team for our wedding. From the very beginning, they were professionally organized, attentive and cared about making our day special. The food was absolutely delicious — full of flavour, beautifully presented, and served perfectly.

Mr. Sufiyan and Noaman both are very diligent and keeps eyes for detail to ensure great service and impressive management through out the event.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for exceptional occasional catering.

featured_reviews.name: Sadiq Zari
featured_reviews.review_text: It seems like all these people have given 4 and 5 stars here, so it's starting to feel like it's all fake because no one can give such ratings after availing their service. I tried them just now for my child's wedding, but I'm not satisfied. Maybe their service is okay for 500-600 guests, but they're not equipped to handle more than that. And their waiters and service are the worst; there's no management. The food was good, no complaints there, but still, if you're choosing them, please pay extra attention to the plates. Hope you understand what I'm trying to say.

featured_reviews.name: Aaliya Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
"I recently had the pleasure of working with Dalchini Caterers, and I must say, it was an absolute delight! Sufiyan Shaikh, the owner, is a true professional with a passion for delivering exceptional service. From the initial consultation to the final serving, the team at Dalchini Caterers exceeded our expectations in every way.

The food was incredible - flavorful, fresh, and beautifully presented. The service was top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff who ensured that every guest felt well taken care of.

Sufiyan's attention to detail and commitment to quality are truly commendable. He went above and beyond to ensure that our event was a success, and we couldn't be more grateful.

I would highly recommend Dalchini Caterers to anyone looking for outstanding catering services. Five stars isn't enough - Sufiyan Shaikh and his team deserve a standing ovation!

Thanks again for making our event so special. We're already looking forward to working with you again!"
